title: Tile and notification commands bypass update-operation ownership
reproduction: Hold scheduled update lease after retrieval before final apply; invoke START or STOP via CommandReceiver or toggle tile; also issue rapid clicks before disk executor starts
expected: Conflicting requests return with explicit busy feedback and no queued mutation; accepted operations own execution through completion; failures release ownership
observed: Source confirmed baseline allowed apply/revert outside the shared lease so an older worker could re-enable after accepted STOP; tile local pending was only claimed inside queued work
fix: Claim application SourceOperationCoordinator synchronously before dispatch; tile observes busy and renders unavailable; receiver uses existing busy toast; ignore malformed commands before claim; close on dispatch and terminal failure; preserve protected identity and consent boundary
test_evidence: Three host security contracts passed; isolated Android API36 and Android Java-image type-check passed for nine Java sources; fourteen new deterministic Android cases plus eight existing tile/security cases type-checked but not run; no Gradle/device/root runtime proof
